results.question: Are ambulance charges covered?

retrieved.title: Benefits Included in Every Plan
retrieved.content:
Pre-hospitalisation expenses for 60 days and post-hospitalisation expenses for 90 days are covered.
Day-care procedures that need less than 24 hours of hospitalisation are covered.
Restore benefit: if the sum insured is exhausted during the year, it is restored once for unrelated illnesses (Gold restores 50%, Platinum restores 100%; Silver has no restore benefit).
Ambulance charges are covered up to ₹2,000 per hospitalisation. Organ donor expenses are covered up to the sum insured.
